trading.liquidityCustodyPolicy: The main VEYL position is a canonical Uniswap v4 NFT minted to the deployer, who can inspect and manually transfer it to the dead address. It is not locked while the deployer owns it. Agent-market positions continue to use permanently locked VeylLiquidityVault positions.

zkapi.daemonHostPlan: Shared-host pilot: one running job and daemon pair, fifty saved profiles, two CPU cores and 4 GiB aggregate memory cap with no swap. The authenticated gateway supports wallet-approved mainnet transactions, per-project funding approvals and owner-approved social publishing. Automatic maintenance operators require separate configuration. Move to a separate server before growing production workloads.
zkapi.reconciliationPolicy: Reserve each live model catalog cap plus a bounded 1000 microUSD rounding allowance before dispatch. Reconcile exact ETH charges only from authenticated durable native receipts bound to the saved call, session, journal and original quote; release unused budget once. Unknown or legacy calls stay held and inference is never automatically replayed. Real funded acceptance was deliberately not run.
